name: OpenComputer

modes.label: Machine time per second (2 GB/1 vCPU default, auto-burst to 4/2 or 8/4)
modes.note: Published as $0.00315 / $0.00630 / $0.01260 per minute, 'billed to the second', only while the session runs; idle sessions hibernate (VM state snapshot) and bill no compute. Bursting is automatic; billing is assumed to follow the tier the machine is in at each second (v1 docs: bill = allocated memory tier integrated over time). Linear: $0.0945 per (1 vCPU + 2 GB)-hour. Verified 2026-09-28: billed on 'the tier you provisioned, integrated over time' (docs-v1.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/usage.md), not resident memory; 'A rolling idle timeout (default 300s) resets on every operation - exec, file access, agent activity', then 'auto-hibernates if possible, otherwise stops'; 'no cost while hibernated' (docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/overview).

plans.name: Pro
plans.note: 'Your $20 becomes 10x the usage credit' = $200/month of credit at PAYG rates, covering machine time AND model tokens; beyond it PAYG. Bill = $20 + max(0, usage - $200). Rollover of unused credit not stated. Credit shared with model calls (API rates) and machine time.

plans.name: Max
plans.note: $200/mo with '10x prepaid credit, at scale' = $2,000/month (re-verified 2026-09-28 on opencomputer.dev/pricing: 'Enough to keep 10+ default machines running around the clock'). The credit is shared with model calls at API rates, so it only covers machine time to the extent tokens don't use it. Beyond credit: PAYG.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Own cloud/VPC, self-hosted connections, volume pricing, higher limits, SSO, audit log, priority support. Unpublished.

extras.price: Passed through at API rates, no markup; $0 with own key or Codex subscription; drawn from Pro/Max credit

extras.item: Disk above 20 GB (closed beta, up to 256 GB)
extras.price: Metered per second 'at a rate comparable to AWS EBS gp3' — exact rate unpublished
'roughly 2x cheaper than on-demand' — exact rate unpublished
Reserved rate unpublished; overage at on-demand

features.ip_note: Browser Sessions (CDP URL, stealth flag, profiles, live view) are invite-only preview; sandbox egress goes through OpenComputer's secrets proxy; no residential/proxy product documented.

perf_source: computesdk benchmarks: cold_start_tti median 75.77 ms (2026-08-07, 100 iterations); burst_tti median 4,278 ms at 100 concurrency (2026-09-16, 93% success; last run 2026-09-25 failed); DAX never succeeded. Measured the OpenComputer sandbox API, shape unspecified.

knobs.label: Share of session wall-time the machine is awake (rest hibernated)
knobs.why: Machines hibernate after idle (300 s default for sandboxes) and hibernated time bills no compute; agent sessions waiting on a human cost nothing.

knobs.label: Time spent at the requested tier vs the 2 GB / 1 vCPU default

options.label: Mostly at the 1 vCPU / 2 GB default (x0.25)

knobs.why: Sessions default to 2 GB / 1 vCPU and burst automatically; you pay the burst tier only while in it. Options are illustrative mixes for a 4/8 workload (0.5 x 0.756 + 0.5 x 0.189 = 0.4725 = 0.625 x 0.756).

caveats: Bare-sandbox pricing is now published separately (https://opencomputer.dev/sandboxes): machine time only, same per-unit rate as agent sessions, and 'Plans and prepaid credit on the agents page apply here too.'

Dated change: July 2026 guides (2026-07-20) quoted '$0.004/min flat = $0.24/hr' for a 4 GB / 1 vCPU default with RAM resizable 1-16 GB; current pricing is $0.00315/min for 2 GB / 1 vCPU with bursts to 8 GB / 4 vCPU max.
Pro/Max: the credit is 10x the fee and covers both tokens and machine time; encoded as fee + included_usd (not fee_is_credit). Rollover/expiry of unused credit not stated.
Agent computers have a one-hour maximum running time and are replaced between commands (PR #806, 2026-09-25); sessions themselves have no time-based expiry. max_session_h left null.
Hibernated-state storage, extra disk (EBS-gp3-like, unpublished), egress, IPv4 and concurrency limits are unpublished (null).

Reserved capacity (15-min memory reservations, non-refundable, >=30 min lead) and Burst Sandboxes (~2x cheaper, restartable, alpha) exist in v1 docs but have no published rates, so they are not modeled as modes.
Isolation: QEMU on KVM per the vendor's own guide. Region(s) unpublished.
Benchmarks: DAX never succeeded; latest burst run failed (2026-09-25).

Pro/Max included credit (10x fee) is shared between model tokens and machine time ("credit applies to both model calls (at API rates) and machine time"); the estimate assumes all of it goes to machine time, which is optimistic if the agent also spends tokens.

SSH: none. Interactive access is a PTY "like SSH but over WebSocket" via the SDK (docs.opencomputer.dev/sandboxes/interactive-terminals). Desktop: none documented; only headless Chromium ("drive a browser").

Fork (features check 2026-09-28): v1 docs say checkpoints let you "Fork new sandboxes from it ... like git branches for VMs" (disk-only or full disk+memory+CPU checkpoint). Docker-inside and /dev/kvm are not documented (null).

Product pivot (2026-09): homepage now 'The platform for long-running agents' (serverless agents defined in TypeScript); docs.opencomputer.dev and its llms.txt cover only Serverless Agents, and the sandbox and browser-session doc pages there return 404. Sandbox docs survive only on docs-v1.opencomputer.dev (older runtime: 1/4/8/16 GB tiers). The sandboxes marketing page is the only current sandbox price source.
